findings.title: The revised six-denominator model still lacks canonical per-unit applicability and surface ownership data
findings.evidence: The design at section 2.2 says project-memory occurrences are matched against each unit's domain/face/owner/impact and surface/pageKey rows are assigned by the carry-over row's owning unit. All ten delivery-unit objects in the reviewed manifest omit domain, face, owner, and impact routing fields, although each PROJECT_MEMORY_ASSERTION_OCCURRENCES row declares applicability=ROUTE_MATCH_UNIT. The authoritative frontend-asset-carryover manifest has 22 surface rows and 25 pageDesignKeys but no R5-CR unit ownership field. U05 and U06 therefore use prose selectors ('owned by UI consistency' versus 'all 22 ... capability closure') and reciprocal OWN_UNIT_SPLIT_WITH declarations that cannot derive an exact row-level partition from the cited source. The mapping set can be complete globally while rules or surfaces are omitted, duplicated, or assigned to the wrong package.
findings.counterexample: A CR00 implementation assigns one memory assertion to U05 rather than U06 and treats all 22 surfaces as U06-owned while U05 claims an unspecified UI-consistency subset. Every source rule still has a mapping row, every unit still has six denominator types, and global set equality remains 150/150, yet neither the route nor the U05/U06 split has a canonical source fact that can make the wrong assignment fail.
findings.risk: The central root-cause control can produce false-complete package receipts across every unit. In particular, the UI packages cannot prove exact 22/25 ownership, and project-memory obligations can be silently misrouted even though unmapped-row and hash-drift fixtures pass.
findings.minimalFix: Within the existing manifest and carry-over mapping boundary, add canonical legal route tuples or explicit applicable memory occurrence IDs for every U00-U09 unit, and add an exact row-ID-to-owning-unit partition for all 22 surfaces and 25 pageDesignKeys. Require set equality, no overlap, no unowned row, no unknown row, and red fixtures for a changed route and a moved/duplicated surface row. Use an unambiguous canonical tuple serialization for rule identity. Do not add a semantic DSL or policy service.

findings.title: Round-1 numeric, authorization, schema, partition and remote-runner defects are otherwise closed in the reviewed design bytes
findings.evidence: Independent recount reproduced 106/39/56/11, 32, 22/25, seven schemas, 1330/880 with 50/742/88, and 150=46 machine+104 human. The sole current Roadmap now matches the exact design-only pause; U04 names platform-access as schema-less and changes its registry ownerSchema to null; U08 binds the exact remote runner path/hash, explicit host fingerprint, registered task, source snapshot, receipt fields and cleanup failures; non-corpus authorities are explicit.
findings.risk: These are confirmations, not implementation proof. Treating them as already implemented would reopen the same false-green problem.

findings.title: The current provider-free-context gate remains red and must not be presented as current closure
findings.evidence: A fresh read-only run failed with 'skill denominator is not five'; the repository has eight project skills. The upstream diagnostic and reviewed U08 change surfaces explicitly assign PLATFORM-BLUEPRINT and verification-inventory alignment to U08, so this is a known current deviation rather than a new design omission.
findings.risk: A future receipt could quote the standards or memory PASS results and obscure this independent current red if business and cleanup/state checks are collapsed.

roundOneDifference.assessment: Round-1 M-001/M-002 were materially repaired by adding the resolver, mapping contract, and ten-by-six denominator declarations, but the repair remains incomplete at the applicability layer identified independently in round 2. Round-1 Roadmap, seven-schema, remote-runner, OpenAPI split, 150 partition, and non-corpus findings are closed in the reviewed design bytes. No round-1 material changed the frozen round-2 severity or verdict.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The remediation direction fits the diagnosed systemic failure: false-green controls must be repaired before contract, owner, UI, DEV, seed and evidence closure. Strict serial packages, one whole-scope implementation review, exact remote receipts and separate business/cleanup are proportionate.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: The smallest sufficient repair is to complete the chosen mapping model with canonical per-unit route tuples and one exact surface/page ownership partition. Replacing it with a semantic DSL, policy engine, second Roadmap owner or generalized governance service would add cost without resolving business judgment.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: The bounded metadata and red-fixture repair is materially cheaper than allowing ambiguous applicability into ten package receipts and later re-auditing every memory, UI and standards obligation.

conclusion.summary: Final DESIGN adversarial round: NO_GO (M=1, S=0, N=2). Counts, current pause, seven-schema treatment, 150 partition, remote runner contract, D-1 through D-7 blocking, and serial W00-W09 scope are independently confirmed. GO remains blocked because the revised source-derived control has no canonical unit route data and no exact U05/U06 row-level ownership for all 22 surfaces and 25 pageDesignKeys.
